title: Solar Impulse 太陽能飛機
summary: 以Solar Impulse太陽能飛行計畫作背景，建立日照、電池、低翼載、結構剛性和日夜能量的相依關係；不推算真機航時。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use Solar Impulse as a background for dependencies among sunlight, batteries, low wing loading, structural stiffness and day/night energy, without predicting aircraft endurance. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 日照面積與發電：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Solar area and generation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 日照面積與發電 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Solar area and generation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 入射日射量乘面積與效率給理想產電；姿態、遮蔽、溫度和日夜循環決定可用能量。
steps.instructionEn: Incident solar energy times area and efficiency gives ideal generation; attitude, shading, temperature and day/night cycling govern usable energy.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Solar Impulse 太陽能飛機實際性能或製程：日射H=5 kWh/m²/day，A=10 m²，η=0.2。式 E=HAη，基準結果 10 kWh/day。適用條件：固定平均日射的教學情境，非Solar Impulse實測或天氣預報。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Solar Impulse solar aircraft: Daily irradiation H=5 kWh/m²/day, area A=10 m² and efficiency eta=0.2. Formula E=HAη gives 10 kWh/day. Conditions: Assumed average daily irradiation, not measured Solar Impulse performance or weather forecasting.
steps.failure: 忽略陰影和電池循環損失，可能讓日能量帳表面平衡卻夜間不足。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring shade and battery-cycle loss can balance daily totals while leaving a nighttime deficit.
steps.check: 比較逐時日射積分與日平均估算，把夜間能量另列並檢查儲能損失。
steps.checkEn: Compare hourly irradiance integration with the daily average and account separately for night demand and storage loss.

knowledge.title: 日照面積與發電

knowledge.textEn: Incident solar energy times area and efficiency gives ideal generation; attitude, shading, temperature and day/night cycling govern usable energy.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再只把η改成0.18；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 10 改為 9 kWh/day。在算式區重算並記下對「日照面積與發電」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only eta to 0.18, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 10 to 9 kWh/day. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Solar area and generation, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 入射日射量乘面積與效率給理想產電；姿態、遮蔽、溫度和日夜循環決定可用能量。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
白天產電足夠就保證夜間能量充足。
optionsEn: Incident solar energy times area and efficiency gives ideal generation; attitude, shading, temperature and day/night cycling govern usable energy.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Enough daytime generation guarantees sufficient night energy.
quiz.explanation: 入射日射量乘面積與效率給理想產電；姿態、遮蔽、溫度和日夜循環決定可用能量。 比較逐時日射積分與日平均估算，把夜間能量另列並檢查儲能損失。
quiz.explanationEn: Incident solar energy times area and efficiency gives ideal generation; attitude, shading, temperature and day/night cycling govern usable energy. Compare hourly irradiance integration with the daily average and account separately for night demand and storage loss.

steps.title: 日夜儲能與可用分率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Day/night storage and usable fraction: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 日夜儲能與可用分率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Day/night storage and usable fraction and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 可用能量除平均功率得到理想持續時間；可用分率、溫度和功率限制不能被總容量取代。
steps.instructionEn: Usable energy divided by average power gives ideal duration; usable fraction, temperature and power limits cannot be replaced by nominal capacity.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Solar Impulse 太陽能飛機實際性能或製程：額定E=2 kWh，可用分率u=0.8，P=4 kW。式 t=Eu/P，基準結果 24 min。適用條件：固定功率與可用分率的桌上算例，不是航時承諾或飛行規劃。 以h算出的時間乘60轉min。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Solar Impulse solar aircraft: Rated E=2 kWh, usable fraction u=0.8 and P=4 kW. Formula t=Eu/P gives 24 min. Conditions: Desktop fixed-power/usable-fraction example, not an endurance promise or flight plan. Multiply hours by 60 for minutes.
steps.failure: 用峰值功率或銘牌容量直接估全程，會漏掉熱降額及任務變化。
steps.failureEn: Using one peak power or nameplate capacity misses thermal derating and mission changes.
steps.check: 分別繪製功率需求及剩餘能量，將備用能量明列且不混入正常消耗。
steps.checkEn: Plot power demand and remaining energy separately and explicitly reserve backup energy.
